confirmed.title: 'main pushes are never cancelled (merged evidence always completes)' is provably false — 7 main-push factory-gate runs were cancelled after the concurrency block landed
confirmed.evidence: Concurrency block landed da70ff5 2026-07-18T15:10:18+05:30 (=09:40Z). Same day, AFTER it: cancelled main-push runs 29642040058 (11:08Z), 29645626309/29645645700/29645674494/29645695905/29645718502 (13:09-13:12Z — 5 pushes in 3.5 min, only the last ran), and 29655844528 (18:25:53Z, headSha 716037330, 'Bump actions/setup-node from 4 to 7 (#6)') — all 'cancelled push main'. Mechanism: cancel-in-progress:false only protects the RUNNING run; GitHub always replaces the QUEUED run in a concurrency group when a newer run arrives, cancelling it regardless of the flag.
confirmed.impact: Intermediate main commits under rapid merges get NO factory-gate evidence at their own SHA — e.g. the Dependabot setup-node@v7 bump merge was never validated by factory-gate at its commit (only transitively by the next run's tree). The comment's guarantee of per-merge evidence is structurally unkeepable with a shared-group queue; anyone reading it will wrongly assume every main commit has a completed run.
confirmed.fix: Either accept latest-tree-only evidence and correct the comment to say so, or give main pushes per-commit groups (e.g. group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.sha || github.ref }}) so no main run is ever queue-replaced.

And because the project is not git-connected, no merge to main can ever correct it — the only refresh path is a human promote that silently stalled.
critic_extra.suggested_fix: Owner promotes the final build (vercel promote dpl_mU2pptyo… or redeploy from main), then connect the project to the GitHub repo (production branch main, root directory sites/theblushlounge.com) like the other site projects. Doctrine-level: STATUS.yaml preview_url entries should carry the deployment SHA they are believed to serve, and doctor.mjs (or the uptime probe) should reconcile alias-served SHA vs approved SHA.

critic_extra.title: Vercel project inventory drifts from the repo: two projects deploy sites that have no source directory, a self-labeled "delete-me" project persists, and today's kairali-com production deploy was CANCELED with zero build-log events
critic_extra.surface: Vercel team project list vs sites/ directory; kairali-com deployment pipeline
critic_extra.evidence: Vercel list_projects (team_PcAcLkSAnWxQBKCjStgYNp4I) contains `kairali-web-factory-ayurvedafranchise` (created 1784385993878 = 18 Jul 14:46:33Z), `kairali-web-factory-villaraag` (1784387063424 = 18 Jul 15:04:23Z) and `stray-empty-bulkoils-delete-me` (18 Jul 14:53:32Z) — but `ls sites/` shows no ayurvedafranchise* and no villaraag* directory anywhere in the repo, so those two projects have no source that could ever deploy; conversely sites/whyayurveda.org exists with no Vercel project (it is a known zero-page exemption, but nothing records that its ABSENT deploy surface is intentional). Separately, kairali-com's deployments for today's #179 main merge — dpl_J46foAEUvruKr8b382i2spHXJx12 (target production) and the PR-branch build — are both state CANCELED, and `get_deployment_build_logs dpl_J46foAEUvruKr8b382i2spHXJx12` returns "No build log events found" (the build never started), while sibling project bulkayurvedaoils built READY for the same push and kairali-com itself built doc-only #174 READY yesterday. The kairali.com production alias therefore stopped at #174.
critic_extra.impact: The per-project answer to "does Vercel deploy this on merge?" is yes/no/never with no registry declaring which — exactly the soil the installed-but-never-fires class grows in (the pilot finding above is the first fruit). The phantom projects imply deploy surfaces for sites that cannot exist; the un-logged kairali-com cancellation means a main merge silently produced no production deploy for one site with no failure signal anywhere — if that behavior is an ignore-build-step working as intended it is undocumented, and if not, kairali.com's auto-deploy just died silently.
critic_extra.suggested_fix: Delete or document the sourceless projects (ayurvedafranchise, villaraag, stray-empty-bulkoils-delete-me); add a per-site row (Vercel project id, git-connected yes/no, production branch, root directory, ignore-build-step) to gates/registry.yaml or STATUS.yaml so drift is lintable; pull the kairali-com project's Ignored Build Step setting to classify today's CANCELED production deploy as intended skip vs silent failure.
